title: Adapter-neutral Runner foundation
objective: Introduce the smallest execution seam needed for multiple agent runtimes while preserving the frozen Run contract and all existing OpenCode behavior.
requirements: AdapterConfiguration is a discriminated OpenCode-or-Pi union that preserves every existing OpenCode field and its encoded null variant, records Pi SDK and worker-protocol versions with the same encoded null variant, and lets historical OpenCode Runs decode unchanged.

ClaimedJob preserves jobId, attemptId, runId, targetPath, operation, controlJson, agentInputJson, and packageDigest exactly while replacing only the separately reconstructed provider, model, variant, and CLI fields with one complete frozen AdapterConfiguration.
RuntimeAdapter exposes one Run-scoped per-Job invocation interface with adapter-neutral candidates, typed failures, sanitized terminal outcomes, and optional attempt observations.
Runner execution depends only on RuntimeAdapter and preserves rolling concurrency, sibling independence, explicit recovery, durable evidence, and complete-set application behavior.

Enqueue validates the existing score.coding.filesystem.single-target capability through adapter-neutral compatibility logic for both OpenCode and Pi without weakening create/replace, no-network, no-shell, or no-discovery rules.

Runner storage keeps adapter_kind authoritative and encodes OpenCode cliVersion or Pi workerProtocolVersion in the existing cli_version slot according to that kind, so no migration or placeholder value is required and historical OpenCode rows decode unchanged.
The OpenCode Adapter satisfies RuntimeAdapter and rejects non-OpenCode or pinned-version mismatches before creating a runtime session.
Regression tests prove existing OpenCode and Runner behavior is unchanged and mismatched adapter identity fails before delivery.
